Description (what to test): Verify the system displays the Email Templates management page with a templates list/grid and actions for Create, Edit, Delete, Copy, and Enable/Disable.
Verify the system displays the Create Email Template form when an administrator selects Create New Template.
Verify the system allows creating a new email template when all required fields are completed correctly and saves it upon submission.
Verify the system populates the Edit Email Template form with the selected template's existing data.
Verify the system saves changes when editing an existing email template and reflects the updates after saving.
Verify the system shows a deletion confirmation prompt when an administrator attempts to delete an email template.
Verify the system does not delete the email template when the administrator cancels the deletion confirmation.
Verify the system deletes the email template when the administrator confirms deletion and removes it from the templates list.
Verify the system shows a copy confirmation prompt when an administrator attempts to copy an email template.
Verify the system does not create a copied template when the administrator cancels the copy confirmation.
Verify the system creates a copied email template when the administrator confirms copy and the new template is visible in the templates list.
Verify the system supports role-based templates with role options: All users, Submitters, Reviewers, and Committee members.
Verify the system saves the selected template role and preserves it when the template is reopened.
Verify the system provides trigger types including submission created, submission reviewed, submission accepted, and other available trigger types.
Verify the system saves the selected trigger type and preserves it when the template is reopened.
Verify the system allows enabling an email template and persists the enabled status.
Verify the system allows disabling an email template and persists the disabled status.
Verify the system uses only enabled templates for automated notifications.
Verify the system allows entering and editing email template subject and body content.
Verify the system saves the configured subject and body content with the template.
Verify the system sends notifications automatically when workflow events occur and templates are configured and enabled.
Verify the system selects the appropriate enabled template based on the workflow event trigger type.
Verify the system sends notifications using the selected template's subject and body.
Verify the system sends notifications to the Submitters audience when the enabled template role is Submitters.
Verify the system sends notifications to the Reviewers audience when the enabled template role is Reviewers.
Verify the system sends notifications to the Committee members audience when the enabled template role is Committee members.
